seed: Adopt useful autoresearch execution practices while preserving FRR exploration and uncertainty.
purpose: Retrospective mapping of an existing pilot, not prospective registration or a new agent trial.

claims.statement: Central corrections survived the four authored continuation-pilot chains; the scoring receipt omission required an explicitly recorded repair.
conditions: One chain per condition; six authored cases and three hops.
This record was constructed after observing results.
Token, latency and monetary costs were not measured.
alternatives: Prompt lengths, summary content and original access differ.
unresolved: Independent held-out confirmation and cost-accounted repetitions.

claims.statement: An adopted bounded loop may make future trials easier to compare and resume; benefit requires a prospective comparison.
conditions: Measurable task, explicit baseline, preserved candidates and independently versioned evaluator.
alternatives: Existing competent protocols may already suffice; extra records may add overhead.
unresolved: No new prospective loop-benefit test performed.
